title: A part with no cost is listed under Parts with no cost
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location is connected to QuickBooks Online, with Inventory Asset and Cost of Parts mapped on its ShopView Accounts page, and that AccountingHub is not enabled.
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Complete, with one approved line with one stock part picked from inventory at a cost of $40.00 each, quantity 2 and a second part picked with no cost recorded.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Close Work Order in the work order header.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The confirmation lists the second part under "Parts with no cost".
  • The Stock parts row reads "$80.00": only the costed part.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S3-E2: “If a part on the work order has no cost recorded, the confirmation lists it under "Parts with no cost" and posts the rest; the hub and QuickBooks entries carry the costed parts only.”
